params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $temp=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-hcp-exact-main-priority'; if(Test-Path $temp){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $temp}; git clone --depth 2 --branch main https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $temp; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $sha=(git -C $temp rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); Write-Output ('MAIN_SHA='+$sha); python (Join-Path $temp 'heaven-bridge\test_worker.py'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; python (Join-Path $temp 'heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; python (Join-Path $temp 'plugins\heaven-control-plane\verify.py'); if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; git -C $temp diff --check HEAD^ HEAD; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'EXACT_MAIN_HCP_GATE_PASS'
